referral.reason: Evaluation of persistent attention and task-completion difficulty.

alternative_explanations.assessment: May contribute to fatigue but does not fully explain the cross-setting symptom pattern.

informants.summary: The patient reports persistent difficulty organizing work, tracking deadlines, and completing extended tasks.
Clinical interview describes longstanding executive-function and sustained-attention difficulty across settings.

examples: Loses track of deadlines when several tasks compete for attention.
Needs written reminders for multi-step responsibilities.
Attention decreases during lengthy independent work.
Fidgets when seated for extended periods.
Sometimes has difficulty waiting during group activities.
